full_name: Jal Mehta | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Social Sciences Evelyn Green Davis Fellow Harvard Graduate School of Education
bio: Jal Mehta is an associate professor at the Harvard Graduate School of Education. His research explores the role of different forms of knowledge in tackling major social and political problems, particularly problems of human improvement. He has also written extensively on what it would take to improve American education, with a particular focus on the professionalization of teaching.
